visual_description: A heavy-duty, handheld GPS unit with a bright orange high-impact plastic casing. The screen is illuminated, showing a topographic map with a blinking 'Find' icon. It has tactile rubber buttons and a small carabiner clip at the top. Next to it sits a classic silver-cased Brunton-style geological compass.

constraints.material: Glow-in-the-dark or high-viz orange plastic; glass screen with 'digital' UI glow.
constraints.background: Isolated on a neutral 50% grey studio floor.
